label: 2027 a year of rain, glory and heaven on earth for the church
description: 2027 brings revival rain, glory over America and the southern states, financial blessing, and heaven on earth for a cleaned-up church, after judgment begins in God's house.

label: A storm over 2028
description: 2028 carries a storm and is the year he is most concerned about, with 2027 offered as a window of opportunity before it.

label: A rapture or catching away soon
description: He says he sees a rapture coming, a catching away, possibly within the 2027 window, and tells listeners to stop arguing about it.

label: Byron Donalds wins Florida in a landslide
description: Byron Donalds takes the Republican primary and then the Florida governorship in November by a landslide, because the Lord's hand is said to be on him.

label: The 2026 election is too big to rig
description: The November 2026 midterms come out fair because the margin is too big to rig, with the swing states and Georgia named.

label: An earthquake comes to the Vatican
description: An earthquake reaches the Vatican, possibly triggered by the Pope's public call for a two-state solution.

label: Greenland back in the crosshairs
description: Greenland returns as a target of American acquisition talk during the 2027 stimulus period.

label: Iraq rises out of the ashes with an economic boom
description: As Iran draws back, Iraq and Babylon rise again with a great economic boom.

label: People refuse to pay income tax
description: From a January 2025 vision: many are disappointed and no longer want to pay their income tax.

label: Northeast migration turns red states purple
description: People uproot from the upper northeastern states into red states, bleeding their politics in and turning them purple.

label: Nations move hard against Elon Musk
description: Europe, especially around the 2027 French elections, and Brazil suppress Musk with lawsuits and platform clashes.

label: Two men try to delay and sabotage an Iran development
description: Through the rest of 2026 into 2027 a development concerning Iran is obstructed by two men from inside, described as sabotage.

label: France's 2027 election replaces Macron
description: France's next-year election is named among pivotal national votes where he hopes liberal leaders such as Macron and Carney are replaced.

label: Brush harbor churches rise when buildings close
description: Outdoor brush harbor churches spring up because a plague again causes church buildings to be shut.

label: Fuel queues over a mile long
description: Gas lines over a mile long, seen in Russia after strikes on its refineries.

label: Judgment begins in God's house, then the world, in 2027-2028
description: Judgment starts with the church and only then moves to the world, beginning in 2027 and 2028, alongside volcanoes and fearful sights.

label: A cold shock-and-awe event in November or December
description: People are cold and there is shock and awe at sundown; he dates it to November or December from the angle of the late-fall light.

label: Technology accelerates into 2030 and the tech already exists
description: The technology behind his tribulation visions was already released by 2025, and accelerations run up into 2030.
